entities.name: Wanda Zabłocka
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Wanda Zabłocka was a Polish botanist, phytopathologist and mycologist. She was a professor at Nicolaus Copernicus University in Toruń (1954–1970). Zabłocka was the author of mycology and phytopathology works, including mycorrhiza of Viola. She is also the author of several books about fungi for the general public.
